commit_message: JIRA-4510: Add index on projects.workspace_id for query optimization

files_changed.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/project-service/src/main/resources/db/migration/V24__add_workspace_id_index.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+-- Add index on workspace_id for faster workspace-scoped queries
+-- This supports the new workspace dashboard which lists all projects in a workspace
+
+CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_workspace_id
+    ON projects (workspace_id);
+
+-- Analyze the table to update query planner statistics
+ANALYZE projects;
